description: Canonical station roster. Crew packs rename these; they never change what a station does. 'retired' maps a station that merged into another, so an old crew pack names a station that moved rather than one that never existed.

stations.title: Design station
stations.purpose: Settles structure and flows in grey, explores several Figma directions, or recreates a coded screen as editable frames.

stations.title: Asset station
stations.purpose: Cuts an icon into the full platform asset matrix, read from spec not memory.

stations.title: Design audit
stations.purpose: Runs independent accessibility and usability reviews using public W3C/WAI references, access perspectives and evidence-qualified priorities. May block.

stations.title: Challenge station
stations.purpose: Attacks the brief, the assumptions and the success metric. May block.

stations.title: Documentation station
stations.purpose: Component docs, design-system guidance and decision records.

stations.title: Specification station
stations.purpose: Measured redlines, states, behaviour and testable acceptance criteria.

stations.title: Reporting station
stations.purpose: Status notes and decks that argue a case, both assembled from verified state and ending in a named ask.

stations.title: Implementation station
stations.purpose: The only station that writes code. Red-green-refactor, then the gates.

stations.title: Code review station
stations.purpose: Independent diff review on another model family. No edit tool. May block.
stations.shellReason: Runs the project's tests to verify a finding before reporting it.

stations.title: Verification station
stations.purpose: Drives a real browser and proves the app mounts. May block.

stations.title: Delivery station
stations.purpose: Files the pull request and reads the checks back. Never merges.
stations.shellReason: Runs git and gh to push the branch and read checks back.

stations.title: Integration station
stations.purpose: Merges every open pull request into one preview and proves it still mounts.

stations.title: Watch station
stations.purpose: Triages new review comments and newly conflicting pull requests, then routes them by ownership. Runs when called, or on a schedule you create with /every. Runs cheap.
stations.shellReason: Runs gh to read pull-request comments and mergeability, and stores last-seen comment and conflict state.

groups.check: Independent checks — cannot approve their own work
